profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer

positions.title: Platform Architect and Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a senior platform engineer, I build and evolve core APIs that power lululemon’s global e-commerce experiences across web and mobile. I partner closely with product managers, designers, and consumer-facing teams to translate business and customer needs into scalable technical solutions. My work spans system design, hands-on development across the stack, and architectural guidance. I balance rapid delivery with reliability, observability, and long-term platform health for high-traffic, customer-critical systems.

positions.title: Founding Software Engineer
positions.description: As a founding engineer, I partnered closely with early users to understand their workflows, pain points, and unmet needs, and translated those insights into product direction. I owned end-to-end development across frontend, backend, and infrastructure, rapidly prototyping ideas, running experiments, and iterating based on real user feedback. This approach helped us identify product-market fit and ship an MVP that we launched as a public beta, while laying a scalable technical foundation to support future growth.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · Node.js · Distributed Systems · GraphQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Serverless Computing · Python

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founding member of the engineering group responsible for data and analytics for the human resources organization. In this position I oversaw teams responsible for application development, cloud infrastructure, and data engineering.

Leading the migration from on-prem data warehousing to the cloud, I built data pipelines from Teradata to Azure Data Lake, enabling faster and more powerful analytics and insights with Databricks.

When our stakeholders wanted more bespoke visualizations than the stock PowerBI charts could provide, I created custom data visualizations in D3 or Three.js.

In addition to visualizations, I occasionally worked on more full-featured applications as well. One of the most interesting projects I was involved in was a custom solution for workforce planning. This was a collaborative web version of an existing process involving many spreadsheets sent back and forth over email. Previous turnover and hiring data allowed predictive analytics to be incorporated and vastly simplify the job of unit managers to plan their future hiring goals.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I'm passionately curious and I learn best by jumping in and getting my hands dirty. During my time at HCA I was given the opportunity to work with many teams on challenging projects across business domains. 

My role involved working with teams across the company to optimize and deploy big data applications on our self-managed Spark and Kubernetes clusters. I promoted InnerSource practices, adopting an internal open source strategy to software development and encouraged open collaboration across the organization.

Being around for a while, the company had some pretty elaborate and antiquated systems that we occasionally had to work with. I used Go to create developer CLI tools that eased some of the pain experienced when dealing with them, increasing both our productivity and enjoyment.

One of the most interesting projects I worked on was a low-level ingestion utility that parsed HL7 messages sent over TCP and pushed them into Kafka for further processing by Spark.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Xcode · Microservices · React.js · Mobile Applications · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Senior developer on numerous client projects using a variety of technology stacks including MEAN, ASP MVC, and AngularJS. Responsible for architecture, development, deployment, and maintenance.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Microsoft SQL Server · C# · TypeScript · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developer responsible for contributing to multiple simultaneous client projects. Wrote applications for various platforms, including mobile, web, and enterprise. Responsible for making technical and design decisions collaboratively in an agile environment.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Led an initiative to modernize a legacy 3D simulation engine with JavaScript, Three.js and WebGL, resulting in improved compatibility and performance, while also reducing complexity.
